transcripts.content:
Alex: Hi Sarah, thanks for joining today. To start off, what is your primary objective for this directory platform?
Sarah: Hi Alex. Our goal is to launch the Apex Legal Directory, connecting certified attorneys with prospective corporate clients across North America.
Alex: Excellent. What key features are you looking to provide for your attorneys?
Sarah: First, we need payment processing with Stripe so attorneys can subscribe. We want recurring monthly billing for our three membership tiers.
Alex: Understood. What are your plans for search and discovery for prospective clients?
Sarah: We need location search so clients can search attorneys by city and adjust the search radius between 25 and 50 miles.
Alex: Noted. Are there any external tools or platforms you need to connect with?
Sarah: We use HubSpot CRM. We want any attorney who registers to automatically sync their contact details and tier to HubSpot via custom CRM integration.
Alex: Got it. And on member directory profile cards, what information do you want displayed?
Sarah: Yes, verified badges on profile cards so verified bar members stand out to searchers.
Alex: Great. We will compile these requirements, verify exact platform capabilities against our knowledge base, and draft the initial scope.

Alex: Hi Marcus, thanks for the technical follow-up. We wanted to clarify the CRM integration and security requirements from our initial session.
Marcus: Hi Alex. For HubSpot, we only need one-way member sync: when an attorney signs up, push their name, email, phone, and bar state to HubSpot. No two-way sync needed.
Alex: Understood, one-way contact push on registration. What about email notifications and spam protection?
Marcus: Yes, we need to customize the automated welcome email with our corporate branding and legal disclosures. Also, our forms must have reCAPTCHA bot spam prevention enabled.
Alex: Noted. We will verify how these configurations are handled in the Solution Center and update the technical specifications.
Marcus: Sounds good, look forward to reviewing the updated document.

Sarah: Hi Alex, our board met yesterday and we have a couple of scope adjustments.
Alex: Sure Sarah, what needs to be changed?
Sarah: First, we are moving the custom CRM integration out of scope for phase 1. We decided to export member data to CSV once a month manually instead of spending budget on the HubSpot API bridge right now.
Alex: Noted. So we defer the custom CRM sync to a later phase and replace that immediate need with data export to CSV.
Sarah: Exactly. Second, we want to add a new requirement: claimable business listings. We want pre-imported law firms to be able to claim their listing with email verification.
Alex: Got it. We will record the CRM deferral, add the claimable listings requirement, verify capability coverage, and update the Statement of Work.
